_comment: Termbase applied by translate.py around the NMT call. '{...}' game tokens and POKéMON/POKé are always masked so the model can't touch them (handled in code). 'types' forces an Estonian root for lowercase element words; 'terms' fixes common word-sense misses; 'caps' overrides specific all-caps UI terms to Estonian; keep_caps leaves every other all-caps run (names, places, TEAM AQUA, ...) English. Extend freely as terminology is decided; seeded from pocketrgb/pocketcrystal.
